**1st: `store.User` (7 packages, ~93 references); 2nd: `store.Memo` (6 packages, ~64 references)**

The data layer is the `store` package at `/bench/repo/store`, where the persistent entity structs are defined: `User` (`store/user.go:29`), `Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`), `Attachment` (`store/attachment.go:16`), `Inbox` (`store/inbox.go:24`), `MemoRelation` (`store/memo_relation.go:16`), `MemoShare` (`store/memo_share.go:6`), `Reaction` (`store/reaction.go:7`), `UserIdentity` (`store/user_identity.go:8`), `UserSetting` (`store/user_setting.go:13`), `IdentityProvider` (`store/idp.go:12`), and `InstanceSetting` (`store/instance_setting.go:14`).

Counting distinct Go packages outside `store/` that mention each type:

| Entity | Packages | Refs | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| `User` | 7 | ~93 | `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/frontend` |
| `Memo` | 6 | ~64 | `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/runner/memopayload` |
| `Attachment` | 4 | ~43 | `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss` |

`User` leads because it is the only entity that also flows through the authentication layer — `server/auth/authenticator.go` returns and stores `*store.User` in request context (`server/auth/context.go:55`), and `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708` resolves the current user for file access. `Memo` is absent from `server/auth` and `server/router/fileserver` but adds `server/runner/memopayload`, putting it one package behind.

Two notes on methodology: `server/router/api/v1` and `server/router/api/v1/test` are separate Go packages; if you merge each test package into its parent instead, the ranking is unchanged (`User` 6, `Memo` 5). Also, `UserSetting`, `IdentityProvider`, and `InstanceSetting` have zero outside references to the *store* structs — apparent hits in `proto/gen/store/*.pb.go` are protobuf descriptor strings like `memos.store.UserSetting`, and outside code uses the generated `storepb.*` types (aliased from `proto/gen/store`) rather than the store entities.
